beats.vo: Hermes Agent is the self improving agent from Nous Research. It creates skills from experience, remembers you across sessions, runs scheduled automations unattended, and lives in a real terminal, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, and Signal, all from one gateway.
One command starts a real terminal session, multiline editing, slash command autocomplete, streaming tool output, and all.
After a hard task, Hermes writes itself a skill, then improves that skill the next time it gets used.
Cron scheduling runs daily reports and nightly backups unattended, delivered to whichever platform you asked for.
Seven terminal backends, local, Docker, SSH, or serverless, mean Hermes keeps running on a five dollar VPS while you talk to it from Telegram.
Most agents forget everything on restart. Hermes keeps a closed learning loop, and it only gets better.
Hermes Agent is open source. Install it, or read the docs at hermes dash agent dot nousresearch dot com.
